author: Bill Ferguson
name: select_duplicates
description: Adds a button and shortcut to the select module that selects duplicate images within a collection.
description-extensive: This tool adds a button that instantly selects any duplicate versions of images in your current collection, making them easy to review or clean up. If you also use the companion selection-to-collection script, it can show the duplicates as their own temporary collection. No extra software is required.
